title: SSE-Bio: A Structured Self-Evolving Agent with Agentic Retrieval Policy for Multi-Hop Biomedical Reasoning

visual_explainer.question: Can an explicit reasoning-gap state route a biomedical agent among no retrieval, graph evidence, reusable templates, or both?
visual_explainer.takeaway: A compact Proxy reads structured gap state and selects one of four source combinations before the Manager and Critic continue reasoning.
visual_explainer.compared_with: Fixed always-none, always-KG, always-template, and always-both schedules inside the same harness.

analysis.tldr: SSE-Bio's useful result is not the full multi-agent package but a matched routing comparison: a state-conditioned four-way selector beats fixed source schedules inside the same harness. Absolute joint correctness is low, orchestration and data-construction costs are high, and most audited failures arise after routing.
analysis.problem: Biomedical multi-hop questions may need graph facts, reusable reasoning templates, both, or neither; retrieving everything wastes context and can introduce noise.
analysis.core_idea: Maintain explicit reasoning-gap state, let a trained Proxy choose none/KG/template/both, then allow a Manager, Dev agent, and Critic to update the answer and locally edit reusable templates.
analysis.agent_loop: encode reasoning gap → route source combination → retrieve triplets/templates → develop and critique answer → update structured state/templates → stop
analysis.retrieval_design: The closest causal evidence fixes the Manager, Dev, Critic, retriever, model, and budget while changing only the Proxy policy versus fixed schedules.
compared_to: always-none, always-KG, always-template, and always-both routing
STELLA and Biomni as unmatched full-system baselines
analysis.evidence: Learned routing scores 16.52/11.73 Both_cor on single/multi-answer tasks versus 13.18/9.02 for always-both. GRPO versus SFT is a smaller 16.52 versus 15.08 on single-answer and 11.73 versus 10.62 on multi-answer.
analysis.why_it_matters: It provides a concrete matched test of where source adaptivity belongs: after a structured gap state and before expensive evidence acquisition.
limitations: The large system-level gap bundles state schema, templates, commercial Manager/Dev/Critic models, and retrievers.
An oracle source selector leaves only modest headroom, while reasoning and retrieval failures dominate the audit.
Inference averages 12.4K tokens, 6.7 calls, 22.1 seconds, and $0.047 per example; data-construction API cost is not fully reconciled.
Template-edit audits lack reported inter-rater agreement.
